data.title: 黑歌 · 深夜被窝的黑丝吊带蜷憩
data.description: 静谧卧房的床铺上，黑歌身穿黑色蕾丝半透吊带短睡裙，蜷缩在柔软的黑色天鹅绒床垫上。两只小巧的猫耳满足地竖立着，双尾将毛绒抱枕紧紧圈住。她微微扬起精致的面庞，金色兽瞳在黑暗中泛着温润微光，像一只找到了归宿的撒娇小猫，向你发出独占夜晚的轻柔呼唤。
data.location: intimate bedroom with disheveled silk bedsheets
data.action: curled up on plush velvet bed, sheer black lace babydoll negligee, twin cat tails wrapped around pillow, golden eyes gleaming warmly in dark bedroom, purring content smile
data.lighting: dim bedside table lamp casting soft glow on pale skin and black lace
data.mood: cozy nocturnal craving, sweet devoted feline loyalty
data.promptProse: Curled up on a plush bed in a sheer black lace babydoll, Kuroka rests her chin on a pillow as her twin cat tails curl softly. Her golden eyes gleam in the dim bedroom light with purring contentment.
data.animaCaption: Kuroka curled up on a bed in a black lace negligee with her twin cat tails curled around a pillow.
